description: I am someone who enjoys learning new things, sharing ideas, and working with others. I like taking on challenges, trying different approaches, and improving my skills along the way. I want to be part of a team where everyone is willing to contribute, listen to each other's ideas, and work together to achieve something meaningful. I am looking for teammates who are responsible, hardworking, creative, and willing to put effort into the project.
summary: Our project, NASA Space Time Capsule, is a website where people can learn about the things astronauts and NASA missions have left behind in space, on the Moon and on Mars. We want to show pictures and share interesting facts and stories about these objects. People can explore what each object was used for, why it was left behind and how it helped space missions. We hope our website makes learning about space history more fun and helps people discover things they may not know about.
details:
Our website will help people learn about objects that were left behind during space missions. Users will be able to explore different objects, see pictures and read about their history. They can learn which mission the objects came from, what they were used for and why they were left behind.

We plan to make the website easy to use, with different sections for the Moon and Mars. We want people to feel like they are exploring space and discovering its hidden history. This project can help students and space lovers learn more about NASA's missions in a fun way.

We plan to use HTML, CSS and JavaScript to build the website and NASA's public information and images for our research. Our main goal is to make people curious about space and show that even objects left behind have an interesting story.
dataRefs: NASA Human Artifacts on the Moon
